name: Mɨchi Əbeŋ Festival
patron: HRH Fon Fomuki Walters Ticha IX
description: Mɨchi Əbeŋ is the Guneku festival of return — a day given to ancient arts and craft, traditional delicacies, the mother tongue and traditional dress. It was revived after a hiatus of six years caused by the armed conflict in the region, and it carries the Mukonge and Kwem dance group competitions.

editions.note: The revival edition, held after a six-year hiatus caused by the armed conflict in the region. Marked by an exhibition of ancient arts and craft, traditional delicacies, use of the mother tongue and traditional dress.
The article announcing this edition is headlined April 2024 while its text gives Saturday 23 March 2024. Both are recorded; the Palace should confirm which is correct.

danceCompetition.name: Clash of Mukonge Dance Groups in Meta
danceCompetition.planningMeeting: Saturday, 18 March 2023, in the inner court of the Guneku Palace
rules: Each participating group limited to a maximum of 20 and a minimum of 15 members
Each performance to last at most seven minutes
All competing groups to be present on the event ground by 10 a.m. on the day

sourceNote: Consolidated 2026-09-01 from the existing update articles and gallery albums. No edition later than the second is recorded in this repository.
